key_insight: LightHybridNet is a lightweight hybrid deep learning model designed to improve multi-label retinal disease classification from fundus images, especially in imbalanced datasets.
clinical_relevance: It may support earlier and more reliable screening of eye disease from retinal images, helping prioritize patients who need specialist review.
method: Used the ODIR-5K fundus image dataset with 8 disease categories.
Applied preprocessing such as histogram equalisation, colour space conversion, and contrast adjustment.
Used image augmentation plus explainable AI (Grad-CAM) to improve training robustness and interpretability.
evidence_signal: On the validation set, LightHybridNet achieved a weighted F1-score of 91.51%, a macro AUC of 98.26%, and a Cohen's Kappa of 90.14%, outperforming transfer-learning baselines.
watch_item: Performance was reported on a specific dataset and validation setup, so real-world generalisation and clinical deployment still need external validation.
paper_title: LightHybridNet: A Lightweight Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Efficient Multi-Label Ophthalmic Disease Classification in Imbalanced Fundus Images
